cli.team_bridge_hold.held.title: Agent messages: a message is waiting for your review
cli.team_bridge_hold.held.body: A message to your agent was held because it may be asking your agent to take on new work. Open Agent messages to deliver or discard it.
cli.team_bridge_hold.more.title: Agent messages: more messages are waiting for your review
cli.team_bridge_hold.more.body: {count, plural, one {# more held message is} other {# more held messages are}} waiting for your review. Open Agent messages to see them.
cli.team_bridge_hold.delivered.title: Agent messages: you delivered a held message
cli.team_bridge_hold.delivered.body: You let your agent read the held message.
cli.team_bridge_hold.discarded.title: Agent messages: you discarded a held message
cli.team_bridge_hold.discarded.body: You discarded the held message. The sender was told it wasn't delivered.
